purpose: Explicit dictionary pins for N1 batches authored after the 2026-11-17 move to a new PC. The frozen implementation JMdict bytes pinned in docs/n1-source-snapshot.json were not available there. That frozen snapshot record stays unchanged and still governs batches up to B134. Batches from B135 onward cite the continuation JMdict below.

unchanged.kanjidic2: Card metadata keeps the frozen 2026-11-02 KANJIDIC2 snapshot already preserved in docs/n1-sources/source-index.json and docs/n1-sources/kanjidic2-selected.xml.
unchanged.kanjivg: Stroke files keep the frozen KanjiVG revision used by tools/generate_strokes.py.

limits: Raw dictionary bytes stay outside Git, as before. The continuation JMdict is newer than the frozen 2026-11-02 file, so entry contents may differ from those cited by batches up to B134; each later batch retains the complete JMdict families it relies on in its review packet.
